name: What documentation should I prepare before requesting a project estimate?

mainEntity.name: What documentation should I prepare before requesting a project estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting a project estimate, it's helpful to gather any existing architectural plans, survey documents, or previous renovation records you might have. Consider what aspects of your home you wish to transform, noting any desired features, inspirational images, or a preliminary list of priorities for your customized renovation. While not strictly necessary, having a general understanding of your desired aesthetic and functional goals can help us better understand your vision during the initial consultation. This preparation assists AKN Design Group in developing a more accurate and comprehensive estimate for your major remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before requesting an estimate, prepare existing architectural plans, survey documents, previous renovation records, and a preliminary list of desired features or priorities for your customized renovation.
